entities.name: Training-Free Generators
entities.description: A category of generators that cater to closed-source LLMs or scenarios avoiding high training costs by feeding retrieved graph data into the LLM alongside the query.

entities.name: Training-Based Generators
entities.description: A category of generators that receive supervised signals from downstream tasks, using fine-tuning for LLMs or specialized loss functions for GNNs.

entities.name: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT)
entities.description: A fine-tuning method for generative LLMs where task descriptions, queries, and graph data are inputted and output is compared against ground truth.

entities.name: Specialized Loss Functions
entities.description: Loss functions tailored to downstream tasks used to train GNNs or discriminative models functioning as generators.

relationships.description: Training-Based Generators for generative LLMs use Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT).
Training-Based Generators for GNNs or discriminative models employ specialized loss functions.
